title: introduce-tenant-kms-binding-enforcer-and-audit-linker
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Enforce tenant-scoped KMS bindings at the service operator level and add an audit correlation proxy that ties KMS operations to tenant/namespace claims. Backwards-compatible rollout with policy flag.
description: Motivation: We need a stronger guardrail that prevents cross-tenant KMS usage in multi-tenant Dedicated/Private deployments while preserving operator ergonomics and auditability. This PR implements a runtime enforcer that ensures KMS key bindings are validated against the request's tenant/namespace claims before allowing encrypt/decrypt/sign operations. It also introduces an audit linker service that enriches existing audit events with KMS provenance (key id, provider, binding-check-result) and a correlation id that ties application requests to KMS calls for post-incident investigation. Design summary: (1) policy-operator plugin that evaluates declared kms.bindings for a tenant namespace and caches validated bindings in a short-lived policy store; (2) request-time gate in the kms-proxy that checks the caller's tenant claim against the policy store and denies calls that violate bindings; (3) audit-linker sidecar that subscribes to internal audit-stream, joins KMS provenance, and emits correlated audit events to the audit-aggregator with a new field audit.kms_correlation_id; (4) feature-flagged rollout behind operator.feature.flags. This description includes a small checklist and rollout plan. Checklist: - [x] policy schema addition and unit tests - [x] kms-proxy binding checks and integration tests - [x] audit-linker implementation and end-to-end tests - [x] migration to grace period for namespaces with no bindings - [x] docs for admin operators and Linear tickets linked. Testing: unit tests for policy compiler, e2e harness using local kms-mock, chaos run for denial scenarios, and load test to ensure latency added is < 3ms p50 for kms-proxy path. Rollout: staged canary (10% traffic) for 4h, 50% for 12h, 100% for 24h; monitor audit link failures, KMS-deny rates, and latency SLOs. Backout: flip feature flag off to revert enforcement; audit-linker safe-mode preserves original audit stream when disabled. Related: ENG-3421 implements the policy schema; SEC-78 is the security review. Links: linear/ENG-3421, security/SEC-78. Notes: No public API changes. Operators will need to declare kms.bindings for existing namespaces or opt into a grace period to avoid sudden denials.

feat(kms-proxy): enforce binding check before KMS calls and add metrics (Ethan Park)
feat(audit-linker): implement correlation enrichment and output mapping (M. Chen)
test: add e2e tests with kms-mock and policy fixtures (R. Gomez)
docs: admin guide for declaring kms.bindings and migration notes (Anita Singh)
chore: feature flag wiring and staged rollout script
review_comments: Rafael Gomez: Can we avoid a hot-path cache miss causing a KMS call to be delayed? Suggest pre-warming cache on token mint and adding an async refresh. Reply (Maya): Added pre-warm on token mint and async refresh; details in policy/compiler/kms_bindings.go; added prometheus metric kms_policy_cache_miss_count.

Anita Singh: Audit schema change looks good but we should version the audit event to avoid downstream parsers breaking. Reply (Maya): Audit linker emits audit.kms_correlation_v1 and we added migration note in docs; agreed on versioning.

Ethan Park: Load test shows ~2.2ms additional latency p50 and ~4.8ms p95 in kms-proxy under 500rps. Can we add circuit-breaker to fallback to deny safely under overload? Reply (Maya): Added circuit-breaker that defaults to deny with tagged audit reason 'enforcer_overload'. Updated tests and rollout notes.
notes_on_rollout: Canary rollout via deploy/scripts/staged-kms-enforcer.sh that updates feature flag for target namespaces. Monitoring: alert on audit.linker_errors > 1% over 15m, kms.enforcement_denies spike, or p95 latency regressions. Operators must add kms.bindings in namespace CRD or enable grace_mode=true for 72h to migrate.
post_merge_actions: Deploy audit-linker as sidecar in audit-aggregator cluster
Coordinate with infra to seed kms bindings for top 50 tenants
Create dashboard for kms_enforcement_metrics and audit.kms_correlation rate
